column2: If it rains, the streets get wet.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If I had money, I would buy the house.
If she had asked, I would have helped her.
If she had asked, I would be there now.
It rains and we stay home.
I had money and I bought the house.

column1: # Придаточное может стоять и вторым — запятой тогда нет.

column2: He would have come if he had known.
I would buy the house if I had money.

column1: # Главное предложение берётся ближайшее, а не первое в фразе.

column2: He said he would have come if he had known.
